notable_updates.headline: Agility Robotics to go public via $2.5B SPAC merger with Churchill Capital Corp XI
notable_updates.summary: Agility Robotics, maker of the bipedal warehouse/logistics robot Digit, signed a definitive agreement to merge with SPAC Churchill Capital Corp XI at a roughly $2.5 billion valuation, a deal expected to generate over $620 million in proceeds.

notable_updates.headline: Hyundai takes 100% ownership of Boston Dynamics as SoftBank exits remaining stake for $325M
notable_updates.summary: Hyundai Motor Group agreed to acquire SoftBank's remaining 9.65% stake in Boston Dynamics for $325 million, making Boston Dynamics a wholly owned Hyundai subsidiary as its Atlas humanoid robot moves toward commercial deployment (including planned use at Hyundai's Georgia EV plant by 2028). SoftBank is redeploying the capital toward its OpenAI and AI-infrastructure bets.
notable_updates.date: 2026-06-19 to 2026-06-22 (deal reported June 19; formal approval cited around June 22)
